svg.title: ISO 1219-2 circuit of the guide 25 example job (lift cylinder 20 kN)
svg.text: Circuit diagram (ISO 1219-2 style) – guide 25 example job: lift cylinder 20 kN, stroke 200 mm, 2 s / 2 s, p_sys 10 MPa
Supply option A (fixed pump 14 cm³/rev, 3 kW) drawn solid; option C (small pump + accumulator, 0.75 kW) in the red dashed box. Rest position shown.
centre: P blocked, A + B → T, 24 V DC
Δp ≈ 0.08 MPa per path at 18.7 L/min
tank – A: 63 L (60–90 L) · C: 25 L · HLP 46 · 18/16/13 · 0S3/0B1 level + temperature switch
A 14 cc/3 kW · C 4 cc/0.75 kW
Lines: thick = pressure / work line, thin dashed = pilot.
Tags to ISO 1219-2: circuit no. + letter + no. (0 = supply).
All parts rated ≥ 16 MPa (rod side sees 14.9 MPa).
Guide 25 §7.9 · step 9 valves + circuit · rev A
